description: A web version of the board game Just One
readme:
Just One ======== A web version of the board game [Just One](https://www.boardgamegeek.com/boardgame/254640/just-one). If you like this (unaffiliated) digital version, support the original designers by buying their game. If you'd like to [support](https://www.buymeacoffee.com/benruijl) me, you can buy me a coffee! Playing ------- To play the game online, you can host a server yourself or go to https://justone.duckdns.org/. Screenshots -----------
Development ----------- Any suggestions, word lists, and patches are welcome!
